title: Underneath the mall is a cave with a metal dragon
content: Never had this dream before! So me and some friends I think were exploring a cave after running into a secret door in a store. The store was a clothing one and then there were a lot of hallways. We were running away from people for some reason. Go in this hidden cabinet door to escape and end up underneath the mall which is a massive damp cave. We are all walking around and then wake up this metal dragon. Which puts a spell on us to become undead people who can fly. So we are flying through this cave and come out and are back inside the mall flying around. Most people can’t see us but the people we are running from sense us. So we fly back down in through the hidden cabinet door back into the cave. Then the dragon decides it’s time for us to die since we were undead for a certain time. Then we all get frozen and I wake up. lol.
